message.content: {"items":[{"item_id":"e071","prompts":["有个同事在我们仓库的 PR review 里留了条评论，把那个 bug 的根因分析写得特别清楚，帮我在这条 review 评论下面加一个 👍 的表情回应一下","这条 review comment 指出了我代码里一个很隐蔽的边界问题，帮我回复个 ❤️ 表示感谢","review 里那条评论的建议我们已经在另一个 issue 里讨论过了，帮我在评论上加个 👀 reaction，表示我们注意到了","我在 code review 里看到一条评论特别幽默地指出了我的命名问题，帮我给它加个 😄 表情","PR 的 review comment 里有人提出了关键的性能数据，帮我在这条评论下加一个 🚀 reaction"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e072","prompts":["我想看看 GitHub 上其他项目是怎么实现 retry with exponential backoff 的，帮我搜一下相关的 Python 代码","帮我在 GitHub 全站搜一下有没有人用 Go 写过 reverse proxy 中间件处理 X-Forwarded-For header 的例子","我要找一个 Rust 里实现 Deserialize 自定义 trait 的例子，帮我搜搜看有哪些仓库","帮我搜一下 GitHub 上哪些代码里用到了 Airflow 的 PythonOperator 且带了 retries 参数，我想参考他们的 DAG 写法","我想找 TypeScript 里 typed error class 继承 Error 且设置 prototype 的写法，帮我全站搜索一下"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e073","prompts":["Our build server has no internet access, but I need to check a package-lock.json for known CVEs; can you run an offline Trivy scan and give me a JSON report?","I have a requirements.txt snapshot on an air-gapped machine. Show me how to set up Trivy's offline vulnerability DB and scan it without any network calls, then produce the JSON output.","Before deploying, I want an offline vulnerability scan of our yarn.lock file. Walk me through executing Trivy in offline mode and saving the results as JSON so I can parse them in CI.","My security team requires that no scanning tool phones home. Scan this Gemfile.lock with Trivy in fully offline mode and generate the JSON vulnerability report, including how to load the DB from a local file.","Can you help me scan a poetry.lock for vulnerabilities on a disconnected laptop? I need the exact offline setup steps for Trivy plus a JSON report of what it finds."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e074","prompts":["我看到我们仓库的 Dependabot 提示了一个安全更新，帮我查一下编号是 12 的那个告警的详细信息","仓库里 Dependabot 报了好几个漏洞，先帮我看看第 5 号 alert 具体是什么问题、影响哪个依赖","安全团队要我做漏洞复盘，帮我把那个编号 3 的 Dependabot 告警的详情调出来看看受影响的版本范围","我想确认一下昨天 Dependabot 发的那条关于 lodash 的告警现在是什么状态，帮我查一下这个 alert 的细节","帮我查一下我们仓库里 Dependabot 编号 21 的告警，看看它对应的 CVE 和修复建议是什么"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e075","prompts":["我们工厂有 8 台机器和 20 个任务，每台机器每天最多跑 10 小时，任务有各自的耗时和收益，帮我用 PySCIPOpt 建个 model 求收益最大的 assignment 方案","要给一群配送员排 route，每个客户点有时间窗，车辆有容量限制，目标是最小化总行驶距离，帮我写个 SCIP 的 optimization 脚本求解","仓库补货问题：每周需求预测有了，有订货的固定成本和持有成本，还有库容上限，帮我用 SCIP 求最优的 inventory 订货计划","排班问题：30 个员工、未来 7 天、每天三个 shift，每人每周最多上 5 天且不能连上两个夜班，帮我建模用 PySCIPOpt 求一个可行且成本最低的 schedule","有一批广告位要分配给不同的广告主，每个广告主有预算上限和最低曝光量的 soft constraint，帮我用 PySCIPOpt 写个带 penalty 的目标函数来做 allocation"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e076","prompts":["I recorded a webinar but the first few minutes are just a title slide with no talking; can you analyze the audio and tell me exactly where the actual speech starts so I can trim the dead air?","My lecture capture always has pre-roll silence from when I hit record early. Find the low-energy segment at the beginning of this MP4 and give me the timestamp where content really begins.","Before uploading this podcast episode, I want to cut the initial silence. Detect the silent lead-in using energy analysis and report its duration.","This conference talk video starts with the speaker setting up while the mic picks up nothing. Identify the initial silent region so I know what to clip off the front.","Can you check the start of this recorded meeting for silence? I think the first minute is just an empty room, and I want the precise cut point where voices begin."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e077","prompts":["我们 Java 项目要在打包的时候同时生成源码包和 javadoc，帮我配置一下 Maven 的 build 配置","我想在执行 package 之前自动跑一部分单元测试，跳过那些很慢的集成测试，Maven 里应该怎么配 profile 和 surefire？","项目里有个自定义的 Maven 插件，我想了解它的 goal 应该绑定到哪个 phase 才能在 compile 之前生成代码","帮我解释一下 Maven 的 clean、validate、test、install 这些 phase 的执行顺序，以及为什么我 mvn install 的时候 test 会被跳过","我想给生产构建单独启用一个 profile，在里面替换配置文件并开启混淆，Maven 的 profile 激活方式有哪几种？"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e078","prompts":["GitHub 的 notification 列表里好多 CI 失败的打扰消息，帮我把这些已处理掉的 notification 标记为 done","这条 PR 的 watch 通知我已经看过了，帮我把这条 notification 标成已读就行","我 inbox 里有个上个月遗留的 notification，内容早就过时了，帮我把它 dismiss 掉别再显示了","早上看了几个 repo 的 release 通知，帮我把那几条我确认过的都批量处理成 read 状态","有个 fork 仓库的 notification 一直在，我不打算管它，帮我把它标记成 done 清理掉"],"rubric":[]},{"item_item_id":"e079","prompts":["I have a branching RPG script written as indented text; can you parse it into a proper graph structure and show me a visualization of all the dialogue paths?","I'm designing a chatbot conversation flow with multiple choice replies. Help me build it as a dialogue graph, validate that every branch reaches an endpoint, and export it as JSON.","My visual novel script has some choices that lead nowhere. Can you load the script into a dialogue graph and run validation to find dead ends and orphan nodes?","I need to serialize our customer support conversation tree so another team can render it; convert this YAML conversation script into a graph format with node and edge data.","We keep our interview-style game dialogue in a spreadsheet. Parse each row into graph nodes and edges, then generate a diagram showing how topics branch based on player answers."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e080","prompts":["我有一张建筑平面图的 CAD 文件，需要把各个房间的轮廓和门的位置提取出来，转成结构化的 JSON 数据","帮我把这个 DXF 平面图里的卫生间洁具、扶手这些图元按图层分类解析出来，输出机器可读的格式","我们做无障碍审查，需要从建筑设计图中自动提取门的宽度和马桶两侧的净空距离，图是 DXF 格式的","手头有一批楼层平面图的 CAD 文件，想把墙体围合出的房间多边形和房间内的固定装置都规范化成 JSON，方便后续做合规检查","请从这份建筑图纸里提取所有 grab bar 的位置和尺寸，以及对应房间的信息，结果要能直接被程序校验"],"rubric":[]}]}
